errors.evidence: This list of values is almost entirely incorrect. The chart only explicitly labels four data points: 2010 (81.0), 2019 (58.7), 2021 (68.1), and 2023 (62.9). The description hallucinates values for years where no label exists (e.g., 2000, 2002, 2004, etc.) and incorrectly assigns the existing labels to the wrong years (e.g., the value 68.1 for 2021 is assigned to 2012 and 2020).

The description incorrectly states there is no visual highlighting of bars. The bars for the final years (2023 and 2024) are rendered in a lighter shade of blue, which is a form of visual differentiation, likely indicating projected or estimated data.
